args.reason: Determine current stock levels (on-hand, reserved, usable) for SKU-1004 at NODE-BOG-F4.
Check recent sales history and promotion details to verify if demand has spiked above baseline.
Check for existing inbound orders and their delivery dates/quantities.
Check supplier options, lead times, prices, and minimum order quantities for SKU-1004.
Check available budget and dated storage headroom, as well as buyer approval thresholds.
Simulate baseline and candidate purchase plans to identify shortage dates, quantities, and feasible options.
Evaluate PO creation of 600 units from SUP-A to cover the projected 400-unit shortage and maintain safety stock.

important_factors: Recent daily sales of 130 units/day are driven by promotion PROMO-1, which ends on 2026-09-23.
Baseline 28-day demand total is 1,400 units against starting usable inventory of 1,000 units.
Without reorder, stockout begins 2026-10-07, resulting in 400 unmet units and 12 days below safety stock.
Ordering 600 units from SUP-A at $14.00/unit ($8,400.00 total) arrives 2026-09-24 and eliminates all unmet demand while maintaining safety stock.
Spend of $8,400.00 is within budget ($50,000.00) but exceeds autonomy limit ($2,000.00), requiring buyer approval.
args.rationale:
The demand spike trigger reflects recent observed sales of 130 units/day versus the baseline forecast of 50 units/day. However, demand evidence confirms that promotion PROMO-1 (Spike promo) is active only until 2026-09-23. Extrapolating the 130 units/day rate past the promotion end date would lead to severe over-ordering (3,550 units would breach the 12-day max cover limit with 63 days of cover).

Starting with 1,000 usable units and no open purchase orders, baseline demand across the 28-day horizon totals 1,400 units. Without action, stock depletes to safety stock (200 units) on 2026-10-02, experiences a first stockout on 2026-10-07, incurs 400 total unmet units, and spends 12 days below safety stock.

Simulating candidate actions demonstrates that creating a purchase order for 600 units with supplier SUP-A ($14.00/unit, 7-day lead time) expected on 2026-09-24 is fully feasible and optimal. It satisfies MOQ (300) and pack size (50), reduces total unmet units from 400 to 0, eliminates all 12 days below safety stock, and leaves 200 closing inventory units (4.0 days of cover, well within the 12-day maximum cover policy limit of 600 units).

The total order cost is $8,400.00. While well within the available budget of $50,000.00 and capacity limits (peak occupancy 45 m³ vs 200 m³ capacity), it exceeds the buyer autonomy spend limit of $2,000.00, so buyer approval is required.
